requirement_snapshot.name: Notes Area
requirement_snapshot.description: Display a notes area section on the home page with a heading "Notes".

interfaces.name: NotesTable
interfaces.responsibility: Idempotent schema bootstrap for the notes table inside initializeDatabase, centralized in init_db.js.
interfaces.specification: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS notes (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, title TEXT NOT NULL, content TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', created_at/updated_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT datetime('now')); runs on every init.
interfaces.test_focus: Table exists after initializeDatabase; columns match Note DTO

interfaces.name: NotesRepository
interfaces.responsibility: Persistence boundary for notes using the shared db_runtime.all helper; orders notes newest-updated first.
interfaces.specification: findAllNotes() -> all('SELECT id,title,content,created_at,updated_at FROM notes ORDER BY updated_at DESC, id DESC').
interfaces.test_focus: Returns seeded rows ordered by updated_at DESC

interfaces.name: Notes
interfaces.responsibility: Express router mounted at /api/notes exposing GET / that lists notes through notesService.
interfaces.specification: GET /api/notes responds 200 { code: 200, notes: Note[] }; Note = { id, title, content, createdAt, updatedAt }.
interfaces.test_focus: GET /api/notes returns seeded notes with camelCase fields

interfaces.name: NotesService
interfaces.responsibility: Maps repository rows to Note DTOs (snake_case to camelCase) and delegates listing to the repository.
interfaces.specification: listNotes() -> Note[] via findAllNotes(); each row mapped to { id, title, content, createdAt: created_at, updatedAt: updated_at }.
interfaces.test_focus: DTO shape and ordering of listNotes

interfaces.name: NotesArea
interfaces.responsibility: Renders the notes area section with heading "Notes" and explicit loading, error, empty, and list states from useNotes.
interfaces.specification: Section aria-labelledby 'notes-heading' with h2 text exactly 'Notes'; states: loading text, error message, 'No notes yet.', or note title/content list.

interfaces.name: Api
interfaces.responsibility: Frontend notes API client; defines the Note type and fetchNotes using the shared axios apiClient.
interfaces.specification: fetchNotes(): Promise<Note[]> -> apiClient.get('/notes'), returns response.data.notes from { code, notes }.
interfaces.test_focus: GET /notes requested; notes extracted from response

interfaces.name: useNotes
interfaces.responsibility: Loads notes on mount through fetchNotes and exposes a discriminated NotesState plus reload.
interfaces.specification: Returns { state: loading | error(message) | ready(notes), reload }; fetch rejection maps to { status: 'error', message }.
interfaces.test_focus: Loading -> ready with notes; failure -> error state

interfaces.name: App
interfaces.responsibility: Reused shared Express surface; registers the notes router additively at /api/notes so the owned chain is reachable at runtime.
interfaces.specification: Requires require('./routes/notes') wired as app.use('/api/notes', notesRoutes) before static/SPA fallback; existing /api/health and SPA handling stay untouched.
interfaces.test_focus: GET /api/notes returns 200 via supertest through the full app

interfaces.name: HomePage
interfaces.responsibility: Home page mount point that composes NotesArea into the main layout container; route registration stays unchanged.
interfaces.specification: Renders <main> with max-w-7xl px-6 py-8 container containing NotesArea; existing route / -> HomePage untouched.
interfaces.test_focus: Home page render includes the Notes area
